description: Run Image Recognition page (dev-only) — displays all image template matching attempts during a workflow run, including confidence scores, matched regions, and annotated screenshots showing detection results.

target.label: Required element for Image Recognition Results Browsing

groups.description: Developers use this page to review all image template matching attempts that occurred during a workflow run. Each entry represents a moment where the automation engine tried to locate a visual element on screen using image recognition. The user needs to see the full list of attempts, understand which succeeded and which failed, and view the confidence scores to assess matching reliability. This is the primary diagnostic tool for tuning image-based automation.
groups.name: Image Recognition Results Browsing

assertions.description: Required element 2 for state Visual Debugging with Annotated Screenshots

target.label: Required element for Visual Debugging with Annotated Screenshots

groups.description: The core value of this page is visual debugging. When image recognition fails or produces unexpected results, the developer needs to see the actual screenshot with annotations showing where the template was matched (or where the system looked). Annotated screenshots with bounding boxes over the detected region are the single most useful debugging artifact for image-based automation.
groups.name: Visual Debugging with Annotated Screenshots

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Empty State Handling

target.label: Required element for Empty State Handling

groups.description: Many workflow runs do not involve image recognition at all (purely command-driven or AI-only workflows). The page must clearly communicate when no image recognition data exists for the selected run, guiding the developer to understand this is expected rather than an error condition.
groups.name: Empty State Handling
